text:
maria: Heads-up — we need to lock down the dedicated-reserve roadmap for Q3. Key decision areas: prewarm credit vesting, spill-to-shared behavior, and autoscale hysteresis. Customers are asking; we need a clear scope by Wed.

kevin: Quick Q — can we split must-have vs nice-to-have? ops capacity will constrain scope.

tomo: My reading: must-have = deterministic spill rules + per-tenant observability + billing hook for burst credits. Prewarm credit vesting can be alpha for pilots.

anya: From sales: top 3 customers want a guaranteed burst envelope and per-tenant visibility of credits. Acme specifically asked for 99.9% for bursts <= 5m and a clear overflow behavior.

kevin: Ops note: current autoscale cooldown (3m) causes rapid flapping under bursty patterns. We should add hysteresis and a minimum stable window. Also need a guardrail so shared pools don't get overwhelmed.

maria: Proposed launch criteria (GA-for-pilot):
- deterministic spill order (priority -> age -> fallthrough)
- telemetry: per-route tokens, latency, and "reserve.*" events
- billing hooks: map credit adjustments to billing events
If we meet these, we can onboard pilots and iterate on carryover and vesting.

tomo: Example of config that implements defaults we're proposing:
```yaml
reserve_policy:
  spill_order: tenant_priority,age
  burst_window: 5m
  carryover: false  # default opt-out
  prewarm_vesting: 24h  # alpha behavior; grants vest over 24h
  autoscale_hysteresis: 6m
```

kevin: Concern: setting carryover=false by default might surprise customers who expect unused burst to roll over. Recommend make it opt-in but clearly called out in onboarding & billing UI.

anya: Sales backs opt-in. Also suggests packaging carryover as a paid add-on for enterprise — customers will pay for predictability.

maria: Decision for roadmap: carryover = opt-in (default false), prewarm_vesting = alpha behind a feature flag, autoscale_hysteresis default = 6m. Deterministic spill behavior + telemetry + billing hooks are must-have for initial pilot launch.

tomo: I'll own telemetry and event schema. Suggested event names: `reserve.spill`, `reserve.burst_start`, `reserve.burst_end`, `reserve.carryover_applied`. Need to add token-level counters to existing traces.

kevin: I'll draft the oncall runbook and the infra changes required to enforce spill_order and hysteresis. Also recommend a metric: shared_pool_spill_rate > 0.5% triggers autoscale prioritization.

anya: I'll prepare customer-facing docs and one-pager for commercial — also loop in legal for SLA language around burst envelopes.

maria: Timeline proposal: dev ETA 6w, infra changes in parallel 3w, docs + SDK + billing integration 2w after feature flag. Owners: tomo (telemetry), kevin (infra & runbook), anya (GTM & legal), maria (product).

deploy-bot: note: canary flagging for `reserve.prewarm_v1` ready for internal testing (no external rollout)

maria: Great. Next sync Monday 11am to confirm dev plan and customer pilot list. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
